blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Class imbalance remains a major obstacle in medical image classification, where rare but clinically important classes are often overshadowed by majority categories. Although current strategies for reducing bias, including angle-based softmax (ABS) losses, offer strong discriminative features, their behavior in settings with a small number of severely imbalanced classes remains insufficiently understood. Previous approaches that estimate the intrinsic parameters of ABS rely on the assumption of many classes, which does not hold in medical settings. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter and an upper bound for the angular margin using negative-angle statistics, and use these to drive a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM), which we combine with dynamically-weighted cross entropy (DWCE) to define our dynamic angular loss (DAL). Across four highly imbalanced medical image classification benchmarks spanning dermatology, ophthalmology, and gastrointestinal endoscopy, our method consistently achieves superior balanced accuracy and the lowest coefficient of variation of per-class recall. Although this entails a small performance reduction on majority classes, the gains on minority categories are substantial, yielding a reliable and equitable overall classifier. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/msalman95/DAL.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Analysis of medical images is a central component of contemporary diagnostic workflows, supporting disease identification, early detection, and follow-up assessment across dermatology, ophthalmology, and other clinical domains.
These tasks frequently require the interpretation of subtle and heterogeneous visual patterns, where diagnostic distinctions depend on fine structural and textural cues. Computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) assists medical practitioners to identify known diseases.
While some of these diseases appear regularly and many practitioners are able to identify them, the importance of CAD systems comes at highlighting rare cases that practitioners might not be familiar with.
Therefore, CAD systems should particularly focus on detecting rare cases, while still recognize common cases reasonably.

医疗影像分析是当代诊断工作流程的核心组成部分,支持疾病识别,早期检测,以及覆盖皮肤科,眼科等临床领域的后续评估.
这些任务往往需要解释微妙而多变的视觉模式,因为诊断的区别取决于细微的结构和文字提示。 计算机辅助诊断(CAD)协助执业医师识别已知疾病.
虽然其中一些疾病定期出现,而且许多从业者能够识别出这些疾病,但CAD系统的重要性在于强调从业者可能不熟悉的罕见病例。
因此,CAD系统应特别侧重于发现罕见案例,同时仍然合理地承认常见案例。

blocks.en:
Many modern CAD systems are based on deep learning, due to its ability to learn task-specific representations directly from raw clinical images ( Esteva et al., 2017 ; Yu et al., 2018 ) .
Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and related architectures have demonstrated strong performance on large-scale benchmarks, including dermatologist-level skin-cancer classification ( Esteva et al., 2017 ) and high-performing diabetic-retinopathy (DR) detection ( Gulshan et al., 2016 ) . However, disease distributions typically reflect population prevalence and clinical datasets are rarely balanced.
Therefore, models operate under pronounced class disparities that influence learned representations ( Johnson and Khoshgoftaar, 2019 ) .
blocks.zh:
许多现代的CAD系统都是以深度学习为基础,因为它能够直接从原始临床图像中学习任务特定表现(Esteva等,2017;Yu等,2018.
革命神经网络(CNNs)和相关建筑在大规模基准上表现出了强劲的表现,包括皮肤病学家-皮肤癌分级(Esteva等,2017年)和高性能糖尿病-肾上腺病(DR)检测(Gulshan等,2016年). 然而,疾病分布通常反映人口流行率,临床数据集很少平衡.
因此,模型在显著的阶级差异下运作,这些差异会影响学到的表述(Johnson and Khoshgoftaar, 2019).

blocks.en:
Handling such class imbalance is a long-standing challenge in machine learning.
It is well-known that predictive models are biased toward majority classes, distort decision boundaries, and – most severely for their practicability – undermine minority-class recognition ( Sun et al., 2009 ; Krawczyk, 2016 ; Rudd et al., 2016 ) .
These issues become more pronounced in medical imaging, where minority categories often represent clinically meaningful but infrequent findings, e.g , melanomas occur notably less often than benign lesions, and exhibit substantial intra-class variability alongside high visual similarity to non-malignant categories ( Gessert et al., 2019 ) . This often leads to reduced performance on minority classes, limiting the applicability of deep-learning systems in scenarios requiring reliable detection.
blocks.zh:
处理这种阶级不平衡是机器学习中长期存在的挑战.
众所周知,预测模型偏向多数阶层,扭曲了决策界限,而且最严重的是其实用性,破坏了少数群体阶层的承认(Sun等,2009年;Krawczyk,2016年;Rudd等,2016年)。
这些问题在医疗成像中变得更加突出,少数群体的类别往往代表临床上有意义但不太频繁的发现,例如,黑色素瘤的发生频率明显低于良性损伤,在与非恶性类的高度视觉相似性的同时,也呈现出大量级内可变性(Gessert等,2019年)。 这往往导致少数群体阶层的绩效下降,限制了深入学习系统在需要可靠检测的情况下的适用性。

blocks.en:
A variety of strategies for handling imbalanced data have been proposed, including class weighting, cost-sensitive learning, over- or undersampling, and data augmentation.
Loss function modifications such as focal loss ( Lin et al., 2017 ) and class-balanced loss ( Cui et al., 2019 ) reduce majority class dominance. Buda et al. (2018) showed that sampling techniques with CNN helped in improving overall performance under various degrees of imbalance.
blocks.zh:
提出了处理不平衡数据的各种战略,包括阶级权重、对成本敏感的学习、过度或不足取样和数据增加。
损失功能改变如焦损失(Lin等,2017年)和阶级平衡损失(Cui等,2019年)会降低多数阶级的支配地位. Buda等人(2018年)表明,有线电视新闻网的取样技术有助于在各种不平衡程度下改善总体性能.

blocks.en:
Angular margin-based softmax formulations provide a mechanism to improve representation discriminability by imposing geometric constraints on the embedding space.
Notably, ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2022 ) introduces an angular margin that encourages compact intra-class clusters and stronger inter-class separation.
Although these methods achieve strong results in large-scale benchmarks, they are generally developed under relatively balanced class distributions and rely on fixed global margin behavior.
In highly imbalanced medical image settings, uniform angular constraints may be insufficient to maintain adequate separation for minority categories, allowing majority classes to dominate the learned embedding geometry.
blocks.zh:
以角比值为基础的软马克斯配方提供了一种机制,通过对嵌入空间施加几何限制来提高代表的差别性.
值得注意的是,ArcFace(Deng等人,2022年)引入了角差,鼓励紧凑的阶级内部集群和更强大的阶级间分离.
虽然这些方法在大规模基准中取得了很强的效果,但它们一般是在相对平衡的类分布下得到发展,并依赖于固定的全球比值行为.
在高度不平衡的医疗图像环境中,统一的角约束可能不足以维持少数群体类别的充分分离,使多数阶层能够主导所学入内几何学。

blocks.en: In this work, we analyze the behavior of angular-margin losses under class-imbalanced medical distributions and address this methodological gap. We derive data-driven upper and lower bounds for the scale parameter s s used in angular softmax formulations, providing principled guidance when the assumptions underlying prior adaptive scaling strategies Zhang et al. (2019) are violated. Additionally, we derive a theoretical upper bound for the margin parameter m m . Based on this analysis, we introduce a dynamic angular loss (DAL) that integrates a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM) with dynamically weighted cross-entropy (DWCE) to improve robustness under long-tailed medical regimes. To assess performance equity, we additionally quantify variability across classes using the coefficient of variation (CoV). Experiments on ISIC Codella and others (2018) ; Combalia et al. (2019) , APTOS Karthik et al. (2019) , and Hyper-Kvasir Borgli et al. (2020) demonstrate consistent improvements in balanced accuracy and minority-class sensitivity.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Research on class imbalance in medical image classification has motivated a variety of loss functions designed to mitigate majority-class dominance and improve minority-class sensitivity. A central line of work focuses on weighting-based objectives.
Focal loss ( Lin et al., 2017 ) suppresses the contribution of well-classified samples and places greater emphasis on harder cases, which are often those belonging to minority categories.
More recently, class-wise difficulty-balanced loss ( Sinha et al., 2020 ) proposes adjusting sample contributions according to estimated class-wise difficulty, providing an adaptive mechanism that increases gradients for underperforming or underrepresented classes.
Complement cross-entropy ( Kim et al., 2021 ) similarly aims to stabilize optimization under skewed distributions by explicitly reducing confidence on incorrect classes rather than solely reinforcing the correct class.
blocks.zh:
对医疗形象分类中阶级不平衡的研究促使人们产生了各种损失功能,这些功能旨在减轻多数阶级的统治地位并增强少数阶级的敏感性. 一项核心工作侧重于加权目标。
焦点损失(Lin等,2017年)抑制了机密性高的样本的贡献并更强调更难的病例,这些病例往往是属于少数群体的.
最近,按类的难度平衡损失(Sinha等,2020年)建议根据按类的难度估计调整抽样贡献,提供一种适应机制,增加表现不佳或代表性不足类别的梯度。
相得益彰(Kim等,2021年)同样是为了稳定扭曲分布下的优化,明确降低对错误分类的信心,而不是仅仅强化正确的分类.

blocks.en:
Another class of methods reformulates loss terms using estimates of effective class frequency.
Class-balanced loss ( Cui et al., 2019 ) derives weighting coefficients from the effective number of samples, avoiding overly large weights in cases of severe imbalance.
AutoBalance ( Li et al., 2021 ) extends this principle by optimizing weighting parameters during training, demonstrating improvements without manual tuning.
Label distribution-aware margin (LDAM) loss ( Cao et al., 2019 ) proposes margin adjustments based on class frequencies, enforcing larger margins for minority classes to yield improved generalization under long-tailed distributions.
Merge loss ( Du et al., 2023 ) makes use of domain knowledge by aggregating predictions across closely related minority subclasses to stabilize optimization and enhance performance in extreme imbalance settings.
Other domain-specific loss formulations have also been introduced in dermatology and ophthalmology.
For example, the adaptively weighted balance (AWB) loss ( Yue et al., 2023 ) estimates class-wise weights dynamically during training and has shown gains for multi-center skin-lesion datasets with substantial imbalance.
Similar developments have appeared in diabetic-retinopathy analysis, where angular-margin contrastive formulations have been used to improve discriminative separation between DR grades ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) .
In parallel, several data-centric imbalance strategies have been developed.
Balanced MixUp ( Galdran et al., 2021 ) adapts MixUp to produce synthetic samples that preserve the structure of minority classes in medical image settings. Scholz et al. (2024) provide a systematic study demonstrating that imbalance-sensitive loss functions consistently outperform naive cross-entropy across a range of medical classification tasks, reinforcing the need for specialized treatments of clinical class skew.
blocks.zh:
另一类方法采用对有效班次频率的估计重新拟订损失条款。
类平衡损失(Cui等,2019年)从有效样本数量中获得加权系数,避免了严重失衡情况下的过重.
AutoBalance(Li等,2021年)通过优化训练期间的权重参数来扩展这一原则,在不进行人工调试的情况下演示改进.
标签分布-意识差值(LDAM)损失(Cao等,2019年)根据类频率提出差值调整,对少数类实行较大差值,以在长尾分布下提高通化.
合并损失(Du等,2023年)利用域名知识,汇总了关系密切的少数群体子类的预测,以稳定优化,提高极端失衡环境中的性能.
在皮肤学和眼科中也引入了其他特定域的损失配方.
例如,适应性加权平衡(AWB)损失(Yue等人,2023年)在培训期间动态地估计出班次加权数,并显示在具有严重不平衡的多分光谱光谱数据集方面有了收益。

与此同时,还制定了若干以数据为中心的不平衡战略。
平衡MixUp(Galdran等,2021年)进行MixUp的改造,以产生合成样品,在医疗图像环境中保留少数阶层的结构. Scholz等人(2024年)提供了一项系统研究,表明不平衡敏感损失功能在一系列医疗分类任务中一直比天真交叉性强,加强了临床类skew专业治疗的需求.

blocks.en:
Beyond weighting and frequency-based corrections, angular margin-based losses provide an orthogonal mechanism by enforcing geometric constraints on the embedding space.
Most such methods are developed for the face recognition task Wang and Deng (2021) , where abundances of classes with large amounts of samples are available for training Zhu et al. (2021) .
ArcFace ( Deng et al., 2022 ) adds a fixed additive angular margin to encourage compact intra-class clusters and increased inter-class separation.
AdaCos ( Zhang et al., 2019 ) removes the need for manually tuned scale parameters by introducing adaptive scaling of cosine logits.
AdaFace ( Kim et al., 2022 ) further incorporates quality-dependent margins that adjust the angular decision boundary based on sample reliability.
Such methods are increasingly explored in medical domain.
For example, Alirezazadeh and Dornaika (2023) applied them to histopathology-based breast cancer classification, and Prakash et al. (2025) demonstrate their potential for improving discriminative medical image representations.
However, existing angular-margin approaches assume balanced class distributions, leaving a methodological gap that we address in our work.

除了加权和以频率为基础的校正外,以角差为基础的损耗通过对嵌入空间施加几何限制,提供了正交机制。
大多数这类方法都是为王和邓(2021年)的面相识别任务而开发的,那里有大量具有大量样本的班级可供朱等培训(2021年).
ArcFace(Deng等,2022年)增加了一个固定的添加剂角差值来鼓励紧凑的类内组群并增加类间分离.
AdaCos (Zhang等,2019年)通过引入可适应的余弦对数来解除手动调制尺度参数的需要.
AdaFace(Kim等,2022年)进一步纳入了基于质量的边距,根据样品的可靠性调整角决定边界.
医学领域越来越多地探索这种方法。
例如,Alirezazadeh和Dornaika(2023年)将其应用于基于组织病理学的乳腺癌分类,而Prakash等人(2025年)证明了他们改善歧视性医疗形象表现的潜力.
然而,现有的角-边距办法假设的是均衡的阶级分布,留下一个方法上的空白,我们在工作中予以解决。

blocks.en: 3 Approach
blocks.zh: 3 方针

blocks.en:
We extend angular-margin based classification by addressing the limitations of ArcFace Deng et al. (2022) under severe class imbalance.
We provide a data-driven generalization of the AdaCos Zhang et al. (2019) scale parameter s s for stabilizing angle-based softmax (ABS), and batch-level mechanisms that compensate for imbalance through dynamic sample weighting or adaptive angular margins. We base our analysis on the angle statistics of the ISIC 2018 Codella et al. (2019) training set, and observe similar distributions across other datasets, so the same approach applies to all of them.

blocks.en:
Under class imbalance, ABS suffers from two limitations.
First, majority classes dominate the optimization because they appear more frequently in the loss and second, a fixed angular margin m m imposes identical geometric constraints on all classes, irrespective of their representation in the data.
To address both issues simultaneously, we combine a batch-adaptive angular margin (BAAM) with dynamic weighted cross-entropy (DWCE) loss.

为了同时解决这两个问题,我们把一个分批调整角差(BAAM)与动态加权跨线(DWCE)损失结合起来。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和评价

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on four publicly available medical image classification datasets:
ISIC 2018 Tschandl et al. (2018) ; Codella et al. (2019) , ISIC 2019 Tschandl et al. (2018) ; Codella and others (2018) ; Combalia et al. (2019) for skin lesion classification, APTOS 2019 Karthik et al. (2019) for diabetic retinopathy grading and Hyper-Kvasir Borgli et al. (2020) for Gastrointestinal findings. All four datasets exhibit high imbalance distribution. For ISIC 2018 and ISIC 2019, we use the official subject-independent test set for final evaluation.
For APTOS 2019 and Hyper-Kvasir datasets, no official test set is provided, so we perform an 80/20 stratified train/test split.
In all cases, we divide the training portion into 80% training and 20% validation data for model selection using stratified sampling.
We report accuracy (Acc), balanced accuracy (BA), macro-averaged F1-score, and the Index of Balanced Accuracy (IBA α ) García et al. (2009) for α = 1 \alpha=1 . 3 3 3 We also evaluated IBA α with other α \alpha values, and conclusions are identical. Additionally, we use the coefficient of variation (CoV) of per-class recall Formby et al. (1999) ; Chen and Hooker (2023) to quantify performance stability across classes.
All experiments are repeated five times with different seeds, and the mean is reported. For Hyper-Kvasir, we use s = 6 s=6 , based on the admissible scale range of [ 2.4 , 10.9 ] [2.4,10.9] , and report results over head, medium, and tail splits defined by Borgli et al. (2020) .

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 执行细节

blocks.en:
We took the original implementations of various competitors and applied an identical training strategy.
All models are implemented in PyTorch Paszke et al. (2019) using a ResNet-18 backbone He et al. (2016) pre-trained on ImageNet Russakovsky et al. (2015) .
Our images are resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 .
Following Deng et al. (2022) , we replace the original fully connected layer with a lightweight head consisting of dropout, a linear projection from the 512-dimensional backbone output to a 128-dimensional embedding, batch normalization, and a classification layer 𝐖 \mathbf{W} .

used backbones, DenseNet121 and ResNet50, and compare against

the same backbones ( \tabref tab:architecture-comparison). For the competing

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we investigated the usability of dynamic angular-margin losses (DAL) for improving predictions of minority classes in imbalanced medical image classification tasks.
First, we analyzed the scale parameter s s of angle-based softmax (ABS) and showed that the basic assumption from Zhang et al. (2019) does not translate to medical datasets with small numbers of classes.
We derived theoretical upper and lower bounds for s s that work much better with fewer classes, as well as an upper bound for the margin m m .
DAL couples representation-level adaptation through batch-adaptive angular margins (BAAM) with loss-level balancing via dynamically-weighted cross-entropy (DWCE), which encourages minority classes to produce more compact clusters and receive stronger optimization signals, and prevents majority classes from dominating the shared feature space or gradient updates.
This joint mechanism provides a robust and reliable approach to mitigate severe class imbalance.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们调查了动态角-边距损失(DAL)的可用性,以改进对不平衡的医疗图像分类任务中的少数群体阶层的预测。
首先,我们分析了基于角度的软max(ABS)的缩放参数s,并表明从张等 (2019)的基本假设不会被转换为数量较少的医学数据集.
我们从理论上和下方 得到的S, 通过更少的分类, 以及比相上方的m。
DAL夫妇通过分批调整角边(BAAM)进行代表级调整,通过动态加权交叉竞争(DWCE)进行损失级平衡,鼓励少数群体阶层产生更紧凑的集群并获得更强的优化信号,并阻止多数阶层占据共享地物空间或梯度更新.
这一联合机制为缓解严重的阶级不平衡提供了有力而可靠的办法。

blocks.en:
We ran experiments on four imbalanced medical image classification tasks and showed that DAL improves classification accuracy for underrepresented classes, and provides a more fair model as measured by the coefficient of variation. In general, our method maintains stable recall across the full class spectrum, indicating that the proposed framework yields robust class-wise generalization and effectively handles long-tailed medical image distributions.
We also highlighted the importance of ABS by adding it to existing loss functions, and observed performance improvements when loss functions explicitly balance class distributions. Notably, focal loss, which is well-adopted for imbalanced classification tasks, rather focused on improving majority classes, and also did not benefit from ABS. Finally, simply relying on aggregate metrics, e.g , accuracy or F1 can lead to misleading conclusions when the classification of minority classes is of importance.
blocks.zh:
我们对四个不平衡的医学图像分类任务进行了实验,并显示DAL提高了代表性不足的类别分类的准确性,提供了以变异系数衡量的更公平的模型. 一般来说,我们的方法在整个类谱上保持了稳定的召回状态,表明拟议框架产生强烈的分级概括,并有效处理长尾医学影像分布.
我们还强调ABS的重要性,将它添加到现有的损失函数中,并在损失函数明确平衡类分配时观察到性能改善。 值得注意的是,对于不平衡的分类任务来说,焦点损失被很好地采纳,而是侧重于改进多数类别,而且没有从ABS中受益。 最后,仅仅依靠总的衡量标准,例如准确性或F1,在少数群体类别的分类十分重要时,可能导致误导性的结论。
